strings.subtitle: — Amḥay n Ifuyla —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Aǧǧer ur yelli. Sqedc taqeffalt n wadda.
strings.ssd_warning: Ɛqel! Ɣef SSD, s TRIM, adis-a ur ittḥa. Ahil-a ɣer HDD wala.
strings.confirm_text:
Afuyl "{name}" ad ittwarmeḍ udi ittuḥa.

Kemmel?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Wa d tastuyt (.lnk). Ala tastuyt s wayes ad tettwakkes.

Afaylu n wawal iɣ tettbebɛ ad yeqqim d amezwaru.

Kemmel?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Wa d aḍebsi n uẓeṭṭa (\\server\share).
Asekcem n yisekkiren ur yettak ara asegzawal n ukkis — aqeddac izmer ad yesɛu isfariyen, adisdukkel neɣ CoW.

Kemmel?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Wa d aḍebsi yettwakkisen (USB / HDD berrani).
Aseqdac izmer ad yeǧǧ tigzirin tiqdimin deg uεessi.

Kemmel?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS (ADS) ur ittwaxdem.
• USN ur ittwazdeg.
• Ttuliwin n tili udi aseḍfer n usigna
  (OneDrive udi wayeḍ) ur ttwaxemmem.
strings.status_full: Agbur ittwarmeḍ s zéro. Aɣrar ur yezmir — ifecka ẓrin zéro wala.
strings.status_fast: Aqerru, aneggaru udi 4 MB ittwarmeḍ. Wayeḍ ur ittwaxemmem, maca s tɣuriwin, aɣrar n ufuyl ur yezmir. Ɛerḍen ADIS AČČURAN i twaragiwin.
strings.status_empty: Afuyl ixwi, armad ur yehwaǧ. Ittuḥa.
strings.error_permission: Ur izmir ara ad yekcem ɣer ufaylu. Ahat yeldi deg uhig-nniḍen. Mdel-t u εreḍ tikelt-nniḍen.
strings.error_not_found: Afaylu ur yettwafen ara. Ahat yettwakkes yakan.
strings.error_is_symlink: Wa d asɣaws azamul. Isɣawsiyen ur zmiren ara ad ttwakksen — afaylu n wawal ad yeqqim d amezwaru.
strings.error_reparse: Wa d afaylu n wemḍiq (OneDrive neɣ am netta). Isefka-ines deg usigna, mačči deg uḍebsi — ulac acu ad yettwakkes dagi.
strings.error_not_file: Wa mačči d afaylu (akaram neɣ ayen-nniḍen). Jer afaylu.
strings.error_hardlinks: Afaylu-a ɣur-s isɣawsiyen n uḥriz-nniḍen ({n} s ummid). Isɣawsiyen n uḥriz ur sɛin ara amezwaru — akk ismawen d imṣadan. Ma tekkesed s ubrid amiran, isefka ad ttwakksen u ad ttwagzemen ɣer 32 bytes, maca tigzirin ad qqiment ttwakksent s isɣawsiyen-nniḍen. Kkes akk isɣawsiyen send.
strings.error_compressed:
Afaylu yettwaseɣẓen, yettwawḥel neɣ d asemmaḍ. Asemmiḍ s 0 ur yettak ara asegzawal n ukkis isefka iqdimen acku NTFS yeṭṭef-iten s wammak-nniḍen.

Kkes tamerkant: asteɣ ɣef uyeffus → Tiɣawsiwin → Tanegzawt → kkes 'Sɣeẓ' d/u 'Wḥel'. Ɛreḍ SHREDDER tikelt-nniḍen.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} ifaylen ad ttwakksen.
Tiddi tummidt: {size}.

Senqed tabdart send ad tkemmleḍ.
Tigawt-a ur tettwakkas ara.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Kkes akk {count} ifaylen seg uzirig?

Ifaylen s wayes-sen UR ttwattisen ara — ala tabdart.
strings.hardlink_text:
Afaylu "{name}" ɣur-s isɣawsiyen n uḥriz-nniḍen ({nlink} s ummid).

Isefka ad ttwakksen i akk ismawen.
Maca tigzirin (32 bytes) ad qqiment daw ismawen-nniḍen deg ukaram.

Ahat tesra-keḍ ad ttekkesed tigzirin-a s ufus.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Snes ɣer akk isɣawsiyen n uḥriz deg uzirig
strings.queue_reason_cannot_read: ur izmir ara ad iɣer tiddi
